meanings.gloss: my (with feminine nouns in the dative or genitive; genitive plural)
meanings.morph: possessive, feminine dative/genitive singular; genitive plural

sentences.text: Ich war mit meiner Frau in Rom.
sentences.en: I was in Rome with my wife.

sentences.text: Bei meiner Arbeit muss ich viel sprechen.
sentences.en: I have to talk a lot in my job.

sentences.text: Von meiner Arbeit weiß er nichts.
sentences.en: He knows nothing about my work.

sentences.text: Mit meiner Frau kann ich über alles sprechen.
sentences.en: I can talk to my wife about everything.

sentences.text: In meiner Welt gibt es das nicht.
sentences.en: That doesn't exist in my world.

sentences.text: Das ist das Auto meiner Frau.
Es geht um das Leben meiner Kinder.

meanings.gloss: mine (standing alone, for a masculine noun)

sentences.text: Ist das dein Mann? – Nein, meiner ist in Wien.
sentences.en: Is that your husband? – No, mine is in Vienna.
sentences.review: This seems to be the first use of a possessive standing alone as a pronoun (meiner = 'mine', with -er ending for a masculine noun), but there is no grammar note; add one unless this was covered earlier.

sentences.text: War dein Tag gut? Meiner nicht.
sentences.en: Was your day good? Mine wasn't.
